setting.Text: PAP alarm overview  ·  page 1 of 2  ·  window summary, daily alarms and alarm rate

setting.Query:
WITH w0 AS (SELECT DATEADD(hour, 1 + DATEDIFF(hour, 0, COALESCE(TRY_CONVERT(datetime, NULLIF(LTRIM(RTRIM('@End')), ''), 120), GETDATE())), 0) AS E1,
 DATEADD(hour, DATEDIFF(hour, 0, TRY_CONVERT(datetime, NULLIF(LTRIM(RTRIM('@Start')), ''), 120)), 0) AS S1),
w0b AS (SELECT CASE WHEN E1 > GETDATE() THEN GETDATE() ELSE E1 END AS NowTs, S1 FROM w0),
w1 AS (SELECT NowTs, CASE WHEN S1 IS NULL OR S1 >= NowTs THEN DATEADD(day, -30, CAST(CAST(NowTs AS date) AS datetime))
 WHEN S1 < DATEADD(day, -92, NowTs) THEN DATEADD(day, -92, NowTs) ELSE S1 END AS StartTs FROM w0b),
w AS (SELECT NowTs, StartTs, CAST(CAST(StartTs AS date) AS datetime) AS D0 FROM w1),
n94 AS (SELECT TOP (94) ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY (SELECT NULL)) - 1 AS n FROM sys.all_objects),
days AS (SELECT n.n AS DayNo, DATEADD(day, n.n, w.D0) AS DayStart,
 CASE WHEN DATEADD(day, n.n, w.D0) < w.StartTs THEN w.StartTs ELSE DATEADD(day, n.n, w.D0) END AS Ds,
 CASE WHEN DATEADD(day, n.n + 1, w.D0) > w.NowTs THEN w.NowTs ELSE DATEADD(day, n.n + 1, w.D0) END AS De
 FROM w CROSS JOIN n94 n WHERE DATEADD(day, n.n, w.D0) < w.NowTs),
pl AS (SELECT Plant FROM (VALUES ('PAP')) v(Plant)),
src AS (SELECT 'PAP' AS Plant, t.[TimeStamp] AS Ts, t.[ID] AS RowId, t.[Source] AS Tag, t.[Condition] AS Cond, CASE WHEN t.[Priority] IN ('High', 'Medium', 'Low') THEN t.[Priority] ELSE 'Low' END AS Pri, t.[Description] AS Descr
FROM dbo.[_Maaden_DCS_ProcessAlarms_1] t WITH (NOLOCK) CROSS JOIN w
WHERE t.[TimeStamp] >= w.StartTs AND t.[TimeStamp] < w.NowTs AND t.[Condition] <> '' AND t.[ActiveState] = 'ACTIVE' AND t.[AckRequired] = 'ACKREQD' AND ISNULL(t.[Priority], '') <> 'Logging'),
a AS (SELECT s.Plant, DATEDIFF(day, w.D0, s.Ts) AS DayNo, COUNT(*) AS n FROM src s CROSS JOIN w GROUP BY s.Plant, DATEDIFF(day, w.D0, s.Ts)),
sl AS (SELECT s.Plant, DATEDIFF(minute, w.D0, s.Ts) / 10 AS Sl, COUNT(*) AS c FROM src s CROSS JOIN w GROUP BY s.Plant, DATEDIFF(minute, w.D0, s.Ts) / 10),
tot AS (SELECT s.Plant, COUNT(*) AS n, COUNT(DISTINCT s.Tag + '|' + s.Cond) AS nd, SUM(CASE WHEN s.Pri = 'High' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS h,
 SUM(CASE WHEN s.Pri = 'Medium' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS m, SUM(CASE WHEN s.Pri = 'Low' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS l FROM src s GROUP BY s.Plant),
slt AS (SELECT Plant, MAX(c) AS pk, SUM(CASE WHEN c >= 10 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS fl FROM sl GROUP BY Plant),
dov AS (SELECT a.Plant, COUNT(*) AS nover FROM a JOIN days d ON d.DayNo = a.DayNo WHERE a.n / NULLIF(DATEDIFF(minute, d.Ds, d.De) / 10.0, 0) > 1 GROUP BY a.Plant),
tw AS (SELECT s.Plant, COUNT(*) AS c, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY s.Plant ORDER BY COUNT(*) DESC) AS rn FROM src s GROUP BY s.Plant, s.Tag, s.Cond),
tw10 AS (SELECT Plant, SUM(c) AS c10 FROM tw WHERE rn <= 10 GROUP BY Plant),
nd AS (SELECT COUNT(*) AS ndays FROM days)
SELECT p.Plant, CONVERT(varchar(17), w.StartTs, 113) + ' to ' + CONVERT(varchar(17), w.NowTs, 113) AS Time_window,
CAST(DATEDIFF(minute, w.StartTs, w.NowTs) / 1440.0 AS decimal(6,1)) AS Days, ISNULL(tot.n, 0) AS Annunciated_alarms,
CAST(ISNULL(tot.n, 0) / NULLIF(DATEDIFF(minute, w.StartTs, w.NowTs) / 1440.0, 0) AS decimal(9,0)) AS Avg_per_day,
CAST(ISNULL(tot.n, 0) / NULLIF(DATEDIFF(minute, w.StartTs, w.NowTs) / 10.0, 0) AS decimal(9,2)) AS Avg_per_10_min,
ISNULL(slt.pk, 0) AS Peak_in_10_min,
CAST(100.0 * ISNULL(slt.fl, 0) / NULLIF(CEILING(DATEDIFF(minute, w.StartTs, w.NowTs) / 10.0), 0) AS decimal(9,1)) AS Pct_time_in_flood,
CAST(nd.ndays - ISNULL(dov.nover, 0) AS varchar(5)) + ' of ' + CAST(nd.ndays AS varchar(5)) AS Days_within_target,
CAST(100.0 * ISNULL(tw10.c10, 0) / NULLIF(tot.n, 0) AS decimal(9,1)) AS Top10_share_pct, ISNULL(tot.nd, 0) AS Distinct_alarms,
CONCAT(CAST(100.0 * tot.h / NULLIF(tot.n, 0) AS decimal(5,1)), ' / ', CAST(100.0 * tot.m / NULLIF(tot.n, 0) AS decimal(5,1)), ' / ', CAST(100.0 * tot.l / NULLIF(tot.n, 0) AS decimal(5,1))) AS Priority_H_M_L_pct
FROM pl p CROSS JOIN w CROSS JOIN nd
LEFT JOIN tot ON tot.Plant = p.Plant LEFT JOIN slt ON slt.Plant = p.Plant
LEFT JOIN dov ON dov.Plant = p.Plant LEFT JOIN tw10 ON tw10.Plant = p.Plant
ORDER BY p.Plant

setting.Title: Top 10 bad actors in the window - click a bar for the alarm's history
setting.Query:
WITH w0 AS (SELECT DATEADD(hour, 1 + DATEDIFF(hour, 0, COALESCE(TRY_CONVERT(datetime, NULLIF(LTRIM(RTRIM('@End')), ''), 120), GETDATE())), 0) AS E1,
 DATEADD(hour, DATEDIFF(hour, 0, TRY_CONVERT(datetime, NULLIF(LTRIM(RTRIM('@Start')), ''), 120)), 0) AS S1),
w0b AS (SELECT CASE WHEN E1 > GETDATE() THEN GETDATE() ELSE E1 END AS NowTs, S1 FROM w0),
w1 AS (SELECT NowTs, CASE WHEN S1 IS NULL OR S1 >= NowTs THEN DATEADD(day, -30, CAST(CAST(NowTs AS date) AS datetime))
 WHEN S1 < DATEADD(day, -92, NowTs) THEN DATEADD(day, -92, NowTs) ELSE S1 END AS StartTs FROM w0b),
w AS (SELECT NowTs, StartTs, CAST(CAST(StartTs AS date) AS datetime) AS D0 FROM w1),
src AS (SELECT 'PAP' AS Plant, t.[TimeStamp] AS Ts, t.[ID] AS RowId, t.[Source] AS Tag, t.[Condition] AS Cond, CASE WHEN t.[Priority] IN ('High', 'Medium', 'Low') THEN t.[Priority] ELSE 'Low' END AS Pri, t.[Description] AS Descr
FROM dbo.[_Maaden_DCS_ProcessAlarms_1] t WITH (NOLOCK) CROSS JOIN w
WHERE t.[TimeStamp] >= w.StartTs AND t.[TimeStamp] < w.NowTs AND t.[Condition] <> '' AND t.[ActiveState] = 'ACTIVE' AND t.[AckRequired] = 'ACKREQD' AND ISNULL(t.[Priority], '') <> 'Logging'),
x AS (SELECT s.Plant, s.Tag, s.Cond, COUNT(*) AS n FROM src s GROUP BY s.Plant, s.Tag, s.Cond)
SELECT TOP 10 x.Tag + ' ' + x.Cond AS Alarm, x.Plant, x.Tag, x.Cond AS Condition, x.n AS Activations,
CONVERT(char(19), w.StartTs, 120) AS Win_start, CONVERT(char(19), w.NowTs, 120) AS Win_end
FROM x CROSS JOIN w
ORDER BY x.n DESC, x.Tag

setting.Title: Top-10 alarms' share of each day's alarms % (target < 5 %) - click a day for detail
setting.Query:
WITH w0 AS (SELECT DATEADD(hour, 1 + DATEDIFF(hour, 0, COALESCE(TRY_CONVERT(datetime, NULLIF(LTRIM(RTRIM('@End')), ''), 120), GETDATE())), 0) AS E1,
 DATEADD(hour, DATEDIFF(hour, 0, TRY_CONVERT(datetime, NULLIF(LTRIM(RTRIM('@Start')), ''), 120)), 0) AS S1),
w0b AS (SELECT CASE WHEN E1 > GETDATE() THEN GETDATE() ELSE E1 END AS NowTs, S1 FROM w0),
w1 AS (SELECT NowTs, CASE WHEN S1 IS NULL OR S1 >= NowTs THEN DATEADD(day, -30, CAST(CAST(NowTs AS date) AS datetime))
 WHEN S1 < DATEADD(day, -92, NowTs) THEN DATEADD(day, -92, NowTs) ELSE S1 END AS StartTs FROM w0b),
w AS (SELECT NowTs, StartTs, CAST(CAST(StartTs AS date) AS datetime) AS D0 FROM w1),
n94 AS (SELECT TOP (94) ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY (SELECT NULL)) - 1 AS n FROM sys.all_objects),
days AS (SELECT n.n AS DayNo, DATEADD(day, n.n, w.D0) AS DayStart,
 CASE WHEN DATEADD(day, n.n, w.D0) < w.StartTs THEN w.StartTs ELSE DATEADD(day, n.n, w.D0) END AS Ds,
 CASE WHEN DATEADD(day, n.n + 1, w.D0) > w.NowTs THEN w.NowTs ELSE DATEADD(day, n.n + 1, w.D0) END AS De
 FROM w CROSS JOIN n94 n WHERE DATEADD(day, n.n, w.D0) < w.NowTs),
pl AS (SELECT Plant FROM (VALUES ('PAP')) v(Plant)),
src AS (SELECT 'PAP' AS Plant, t.[TimeStamp] AS Ts, t.[ID] AS RowId, t.[Source] AS Tag, t.[Condition] AS Cond, CASE WHEN t.[Priority] IN ('High', 'Medium', 'Low') THEN t.[Priority] ELSE 'Low' END AS Pri, t.[Description] AS Descr
FROM dbo.[_Maaden_DCS_ProcessAlarms_1] t WITH (NOLOCK) CROSS JOIN w
WHERE t.[TimeStamp] >= w.StartTs AND t.[TimeStamp] < w.NowTs AND t.[Condition] <> '' AND t.[ActiveState] = 'ACTIVE' AND t.[AckRequired] = 'ACKREQD' AND ISNULL(t.[Priority], '') <> 'Logging'),
a AS (SELECT s.Plant, DATEDIFF(day, w.D0, s.Ts) AS DayNo, COUNT(*) AS n FROM src s CROSS JOIN w GROUP BY s.Plant, DATEDIFF(day, w.D0, s.Ts)),
tc AS (SELECT s.Plant, DATEDIFF(day, w.D0, s.Ts) AS DayNo, COUNT(*) AS c,
 ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY s.Plant, DATEDIFF(day, w.D0, s.Ts) ORDER BY COUNT(*) DESC) AS rn
 FROM src s CROSS JOIN w GROUP BY s.Plant, DATEDIFF(day, w.D0, s.Ts), s.Tag, s.Cond),
t10 AS (SELECT Plant, DayNo, SUM(c) AS c10 FROM tc WHERE rn <= 10 GROUP BY Plant, DayNo)
SELECT CONVERT(varchar(6), d.DayStart, 106) AS Day_label, CONVERT(char(8), d.DayStart, 112) AS [Day], CONVERT(varchar(11), d.DayStart, 106) AS Day_text,
CONVERT(char(19), w.StartTs, 120) AS Win_start, CONVERT(char(19), w.NowTs, 120) AS Win_end,
MAX(CASE WHEN p.Plant = 'PAP' THEN CAST(100.0 * ISNULL(t10.c10, 0) / NULLIF(a.n, 0) AS decimal(9,1)) END) AS PAP
FROM days d CROSS JOIN w CROSS JOIN pl p
LEFT JOIN a ON a.Plant = p.Plant AND a.DayNo = d.DayNo
LEFT JOIN t10 ON t10.Plant = p.Plant AND t10.DayNo = d.DayNo
GROUP BY d.DayStart, w.StartTs, w.NowTs
ORDER BY d.DayStart

setting.Title: @DayText - alarms per hour by priority
setting.Query:
WITH w1 AS (SELECT ISNULL(TRY_CONVERT(datetime, NULLIF('@WinEnd', ''), 120), GETDATE()) AS NowTs, TRY_CONVERT(datetime, NULLIF('@WinStart', ''), 120) AS S1),
w AS (SELECT NowTs, ISNULL(S1, DATEADD(day, -30, NowTs)) AS StartTs, CAST(CAST(ISNULL(S1, DATEADD(day, -30, NowTs)) AS date) AS datetime) AS D0 FROM w1),
p AS (SELECT z.DayStart, CASE WHEN z.DayStart < w.StartTs THEN w.StartTs ELSE z.DayStart END AS Ds,
 CASE WHEN DATEADD(day, 1, z.DayStart) > w.NowTs THEN w.NowTs ELSE DATEADD(day, 1, z.DayStart) END AS De
 FROM w CROSS APPLY (SELECT TRY_CONVERT(datetime, NULLIF('@Day', ''), 112) AS DayStart) z WHERE z.DayStart IS NOT NULL),
src AS (SELECT 'PAP' AS Plant, t.[TimeStamp] AS Ts, t.[ID] AS RowId, t.[Source] AS Tag, t.[Condition] AS Cond, CASE WHEN t.[Priority] IN ('High', 'Medium', 'Low') THEN t.[Priority] ELSE 'Low' END AS Pri, t.[Description] AS Descr
FROM dbo.[_Maaden_DCS_ProcessAlarms_1] t WITH (NOLOCK) CROSS JOIN p
WHERE t.[TimeStamp] >= p.Ds AND t.[TimeStamp] < p.De AND t.[Condition] <> '' AND t.[ActiveState] = 'ACTIVE' AND t.[AckRequired] = 'ACKREQD' AND ISNULL(t.[Priority], '') <> 'Logging'),
h24 AS (SELECT TOP (24) ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY (SELECT NULL)) - 1 AS h FROM sys.all_objects),
a AS (SELECT DATEPART(hour, s.Ts) AS h, SUM(CASE WHEN s.Pri = 'High' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS H, SUM(CASE WHEN s.Pri = 'Medium' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS M,
 SUM(CASE WHEN s.Pri = 'Low' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS L FROM src s GROUP BY DATEPART(hour, s.Ts))
SELECT RIGHT('0' + CAST(h24.h AS varchar(2)), 2) + ':00' AS Hour_label, ISNULL(a.H, 0) AS High, ISNULL(a.M, 0) AS Medium, ISNULL(a.L, 0) AS Low
FROM h24 LEFT JOIN a ON a.h = h24.h
WHERE '@Day' <> ''
ORDER BY h24.h

w AS (SELECT NowTs, ISNULL(S1, DATEADD(day, -30, NowTs)) AS StartTs, CAST(CAST(ISNULL(S1, DATEADD(day, -30, NowTs)) AS date) AS datetime) AS D0 FROM w1),
p AS (SELECT z.DayStart, CASE WHEN z.DayStart < w.StartTs THEN w.StartTs ELSE z.DayStart END AS Ds,
 CASE WHEN DATEADD(day, 1, z.DayStart) > w.NowTs THEN w.NowTs ELSE DATEADD(day, 1, z.DayStart) END AS De
 FROM w CROSS APPLY (SELECT TRY_CONVERT(datetime, NULLIF('@Day', ''), 112) AS DayStart) z WHERE z.DayStart IS NOT NULL),
src AS (SELECT 'PAP' AS Plant, t.[TimeStamp] AS Ts, t.[ID] AS RowId, t.[Source] AS Tag, t.[Condition] AS Cond, CASE WHEN t.[Priority] IN ('High', 'Medium', 'Low') THEN t.[Priority] ELSE 'Low' END AS Pri, t.[Description] AS Descr

n144 AS (SELECT TOP (144) ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY (SELECT NULL)) - 1 AS k FROM sys.all_objects),
a AS (SELECT s.Plant, DATEDIFF(minute, p.DayStart, s.Ts) / 10 AS k, COUNT(*) AS n FROM src s CROSS JOIN p GROUP BY s.Plant, DATEDIFF(minute, p.DayStart, s.Ts) / 10)

WITH w1 AS (SELECT ISNULL(TRY_CONVERT(datetime, NULLIF('@WinEnd', ''), 120), GETDATE()) AS NowTs, TRY_CONVERT(datetime, NULLIF('@WinStart', ''), 120) AS S1),

src AS (SELECT 'PAP' AS Plant, t.[TimeStamp] AS Ts, t.[ID] AS RowId, t.[Source] AS Tag, t.[Condition] AS Cond, CASE WHEN t.[Priority] IN ('High', 'Medium', 'Low') THEN t.[Priority] ELSE 'Low' END AS Pri, t.[Description] AS Descr
